arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/run.test.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('const REF = "refs/pi/threads/42";','const REF = "refs/pi/threads/42";\n/** Where a run keeps REF locally (liveRef()). */\nconst LIVE = "refs/pi-action/threads/42";',1)
s=s.replace('expect(tipWhenShown).toBe(git(deps.cwd, "rev-parse", REF).trim());','expect(tipWhenShown).toBe(git(deps.cwd, "rev-parse", LIVE).trim());')
s=s.replace('''		const tip = git(deps.cwd, "rev-parse", REF).trim();
		const parent = git(deps.cwd, "rev-parse", `${REF}~3`).trim();''','''		const tip = git(deps.cwd, "rev-parse", LIVE).trim();
		const parent = git(deps.cwd, "rev-parse", `${LIVE}~3`).trim();''')
s=s.replace('''			git(deps.cwd, "rev-parse", WORKTREES).trim(),''','''			git(deps.cwd, "rev-parse", WORKTREES.replace("refs/pi/", "refs/pi-action/")).trim(),''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
timeout 600 npx vitest run src/run.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|Tests " | head
